content.method: Current read-only OS, CPU, repository disk and Python queries; each child records actual viewport, DPI, theme, motion and loaded runtime. Power and unrelated workload remain unknown.

content.authority: diagnostic; sparse medians/ranges, no p95 or latency gate
content.intervals: Legacy standard totals include input time; after_last_input metrics exclude it. Steady settlement starts at drive end. Frame intervals are observed animation-frame cadence, not monitor refresh or compositor evidence.
